ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure shows the distribution of nuclear power plants along China's eastern coastal area. The marked nuclear power plants include Tianwan Nuclear Power Plant, Qinshan Nuclear Power Plant, Ningde Nuclear Power Plant, as well as Daya Bay Nuclear Power Plant, Ling'ao Nuclear Power Plant, etc., and their locations are mainly concentrated in the eastern and southeastern coastal regions. Reasoning: the question stem asks us to judge the conventional energy condition of this region according to the distribution characteristics of nuclear power plants. Nuclear power plants being concentrated in the eastern coast indicates that these regions are economically developed and have large electricity demand, but the supply of conventional energy such as coal and petroleum is relatively insufficient, and nuclear energy needs to be developed to supplement energy. Therefore, the conventional energy condition of this region is lacking.
